resources.string: The connection to %1$s is being intercepted: the certificate is not GitHub\'s own. OpenHub did not send the request, so your sign-in did not travel over this connection.\n\nThis happens when certificate checks are switched off in OpenHub (an SSL unpinning module) or a proxy certificate was added to the system. Your account is kept. When the interception stops, OpenHub works again at once.
Root: not found (root can be hidden)
